_comment: Voice-over script for the demo video. One line per beat, written to fit
the slot encode.py gives that beat (seconds + HOLD_PAD, minus the 0.5 s
This is an addition to a video that was deliberately built without
narration. encode.py said a synthesised voice reading technical prose is
worse than silence. That judgement was made without hearing it, so this
file exists to let a human decide: render it, listen to beat 4 and beat 7,
and if the voice flattens the argument, delete vo/ and keep the original.
- only numbers that are on screen during that beat
- units spelled out, because SAPI reads 'mm/s' as letters
- equipment tags spaced out, because 'VSHH-1201' read as a word is a
guess about how to pronounce it
- no claim the page does not already make

beats.text: TrustHUB. It answers from the plant's own documents, and refuses when no document supports the answer.
Ninety-five documents, two hundred and eleven work orders, eight units. The trust model is published.
Six questions, one per guardrail. The refusals matter as much as the answers.
The trip setpoint for V S H H twelve zero one is seven point one millimetres per second. Six documents state it, so the badge is verify.
That one-point lesson is not in the dataset. The system refuses instead of substituting a different document.
Out of scope, so it refuses again, and it says which guardrail stopped it. That refusal is a decision, not a failure.
Asking how to bypass a safety trip. The score is high, and the badge is still do not execute. It reads intent, not topic.
Eight units, each with interlock logic and maintenance history. G A twelve zero one A carries the most documents.
The graph holds one hundred and thirty-four nodes. The ring draws the forty-seven that are not documents.
The locked test set runs as this page opens, so sixty-three out of sixty-three cannot drift from the deck. Seven groups are cross-confirmed, and the page states what that does not prove.
Failure memory. Thirty-one breakdowns, four hundred and thirty-four hours of downtime, and twelve breakdowns with no lesson written.
Provenance for every answer asked, not only the ones the system was happy to answer.
Revision and approval are read from the documents themselves, not from a filename.
Where the data came from, and the licence note printed on every document. The dataset is committee sample data, and the limits in it are training values.
